text:
(3) In such a case the court must review that question, and if it concludes that it
is in the public interest to disclose material to any extent—
(a) it shall so order; and
(b) it shall take such steps as are reasonable to inform the prosecutor
of its order.

(4) Where the prosecutor is informed of an order made under subsection (3) he
must act accordingly having regard to the provisions of this Part (unless he
decides not to proceed with the case concerned).”
